name: Statusnook
description: Effortlessly deploy a status page and start monitoring endpoints in minutes
composeYaml:
services:
  statusnook:
    environment:
    volumes:
      - 'statusnook-data:/app/statusnook-data'
    image: goksan/statusnook:latest
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '--spider'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
